_readme: Floral tributes. Prices in Barbados dollars (Bds$). price null = 'Price on request'. 'priceText' overrides the shown price. 'desc' adds a small line under the price. 'fit':'contain' shows the whole photo. EVERY tribute offers the shared 'colours' list below; a product's 'photos' map (colour -> image slug) swaps the card photo for the colours we have a photo of, and 'default' is the colour shown first. Images: images/flowers/<slug>.jpg plus a ~700px copy in images/thumbs/<slug>.jpg. A product can override the colour list with its own 'colours'. items.name: Lettered Tribute
items.desc: MUM, DAD, GRAN, UNCLE or any name. Tell us the word and the colour, and we will confirm the price.
